label.en: Who the controller is and who the processor is
label.da: Hvem der er dataansvarlig, og hvem der er databehandler
label.de: Wer Verantwortlicher und wer Auftragsverarbeiter ist

elements.asks: which party is the controller and which is the processor, named so the contract binds the processor with regard to the controller

citation.note: a contract binding on the processor with regard to the controller

label.en: The subject-matter and duration of the processing

elements.asks: the subject-matter of the processing and how long it lasts

citation.note: sets out the subject-matter and duration of the processing

label.en: The nature and purpose of the processing

elements.asks: the nature and purpose of the processing

citation.note: sets out the nature and purpose of the processing

label.en: The types of personal data and the categories of data subjects
label.da: Typen af personoplysninger og kategorierne af registrerede
label.de: Die Art der personenbezogenen Daten und die Kategorien betroffener Personen

elements.asks: the types of personal data processed and the categories of data subjects they concern

citation.note: sets out the type of personal data and categories of data subjects

label.en: The obligations and rights of the controller
label.de: Die Pflichten und Rechte des Verantwortlichen

elements.asks: the obligations and rights of the controller under the contract

citation.note: sets out the obligations and rights of the controller

label.en: Processing only on the controller's documented instructions
label.da: Behandling kun efter dokumenteret instruks fra den dataansvarlige
label.de: Verarbeitung nur auf dokumentierte Weisung des Verantwortlichen

elements.asks: that the processor processes the personal data only on documented instructions from the controller, including for any transfer to a third country

label.en: Confidentiality of the people who process the data
label.da: Fortrolighed for de personer, der behandler oplysningerne
label.de: Vertraulichkeit der zur Verarbeitung befugten Personen

elements.asks: that the persons authorised to process the data have committed themselves to confidentiality or are under a statutory duty of confidentiality

citation.note: persons authorised have committed to confidentiality

label.en: The security measures the processor takes

elements.asks: that the processor takes the technical and organisational security measures required, and what they are

citation.note: takes all measures required pursuant to Article 32

label.en: Sub-processors only with the controller's prior written authorisation
label.da: Underdatabehandlere kun med den dataansvarliges forudgående skriftlige godkendelse
label.de: Unterauftragsverarbeiter nur mit vorheriger schriftlicher Genehmigung des Verantwortlichen

elements.asks: that the processor engages another processor only with the controller's prior specific or general written authorisation, and that the same obligations are imposed on that other processor

citation.note: no other processor without prior written authorisation

label.en: Notice of new sub-processors and a way to object
label.da: Varsel om nye underdatabehandlere og en mulighed for at gøre indsigelse
label.de: Ankündigung neuer Unterauftragsverarbeiter und eine Möglichkeit zum Widerspruch

elements.asks: that the processor informs the controller of any intended addition or replacement of a sub-processor in advance and gives the controller the opportunity to object, with how much notice and how

citation.note: inform of intended changes, giving the opportunity to object

label.en: Help with requests from the people whose data it is
label.da: Hjælp til anmodninger fra de registrerede

elements.asks: that the processor assists the controller in responding to requests from data subjects exercising their rights

label.en: Help with security, breach handling and impact assessments
label.da: Hjælp med sikkerhed, håndtering af brud og konsekvensanalyser
label.de: Unterstützung bei Sicherheit, Verletzungen und Folgenabschätzungen

elements.asks: that the processor assists the controller with its obligations on security, notification of breaches and data protection impact assessments

citation.note: assists with the obligations in Articles 32 to 36

label.en: Notice of a personal data breach, and how fast
label.da: Underretning om brud på persondatasikkerheden, og hvor hurtigt
label.de: Meldung einer Verletzung des Schutzes personenbezogener Daten, und wie schnell

elements.asks: that the processor notifies the controller of a personal data breach after becoming aware of it, and the time within which it commits to do so

citation.note: the processor notifies the controller without undue delay

label.en: Deletion or return of the data when the service ends
label.da: Sletning eller tilbagelevering af oplysningerne, når ydelsen ophører
label.de: Löschung oder Rückgabe der Daten nach Ende der Leistung

elements.asks: that at the end of the service the processor deletes or returns all the personal data, at the controller's choice, and deletes existing copies

citation.note: deletes or returns all the personal data at the end

label.en: Information and audits to show the contract is kept
label.da: Oplysninger og revisioner, der viser, at aftalen overholdes
label.de: Informationen und Überprüfungen zum Nachweis der Vertragserfüllung

elements.asks: that the processor makes available the information needed to demonstrate its obligations are met and allows for and contributes to audits and inspections by the controller or an auditor it mandates

citation.note: makes information available and allows audits

label.en: Transfers outside the EEA, and the safeguard they rest on
label.da: Overførsler uden for EØS, og det grundlag de hviler på
label.de: Übermittlungen außerhalb des EWR und die Garantie, auf der sie beruhen

elements.asks: whether personal data is transferred to a country outside the EEA and, if so, the safeguard the transfer rests on (standard contractual clauses annexed to the agreement, an adequacy decision or binding corporate rules), or a statement that no such transfer takes place

citation.note: a transfer only with appropriate safeguards
